## HubSpot Renewal Pipeline Series

### [Complete Guide to Building a Renewal Pipeline in HubSpot](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-pipeline-complete-guide)
The definitive guide to building a HubSpot renewal pipeline: from architecture and automation to dashboards and churn prevention. Everything mid-market teams need to stop losing renewals.

### [Renewal Pipeline vs Sales Pipeline](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-pipeline-vs-sales-pipeline)
The #1 HubSpot community debate: should renewals live in your sales pipeline or get their own? A decision framework based on team size, contract complexity, and reporting needs.

### [Renewal Pipeline Stages (3 proven models)](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-pipeline-stages)
Three proven HubSpot renewal pipeline stage models: time-based, activity-based, and customer-journey, with exact stage definitions, probability weights, and when to use each.

### [The 15 Custom Properties Every Renewal Pipeline Needs](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-pipeline-properties)
Complete property setup guide for HubSpot renewal pipelines: deal type, renewal date, contract term, churn reason, health score, and 10 more. Exact field types, dropdown values, and where each lives.

### [Renewal Deal Workflow Automation](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-deal-workflow-automation)
Build HubSpot workflows that create renewal deals, copy the right properties, preserve renewal context, trigger 90-60-30 tasks, and avoid data leakage in NRR and GRR reporting.

### [Fixing the Renewal Workflow Infinite Loop](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-workflow-infinite-loop-fix)
HubSpot's re-enrollment blocking breaks multi-year renewal automation after Year 1. Here are four proven solutions, from the dual-workflow pattern to boolean toggles, that keep the chain going.

### [NRR and GRR Dashboard Reporting](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-nrr-grr-dashboard-reporting)
How to report NRR, GRR, renewal rate, churn, expansion, and contraction in HubSpot using renewal properties, clean deal lineage, and custom dashboards.

### [Renewal Forecasting Accuracy](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-forecasting-accuracy)
Renewal deals close at 85 to 95 percent while new business closes at 20 to 30 percent. If you are using the same forecast model for both, your numbers are fiction. Here is how to fix HubSpot renewal forecasting.

### [Expansion Pipeline Structure](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-expansion-pipeline-structure)
Where should expansion revenue live in HubSpot? How do you prevent double-counting? This guide covers multi-pipeline architecture for renewals, expansions, and downgrades.

### [Churn Prevention with Health Scores](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-churn-prevention-health-scores-workflows)
From health score setup to at-risk alert workflows, churn reason taxonomies, and win-back sequences. A practical guide to preventing churn before the renewal conversation starts.

### [12 Renewal Pipeline Mistakes Costing Revenue](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-renewal-pipeline-mistakes-costing-revenue)
The most common renewal pipeline mistakes we see in HubSpot: from mixing deal types to ignoring silence, timing collisions, and unstandardized churn logging. Each mistake includes the fix.

## HubSpot Deal Cloning Series

### [Complete Guide to Cloning a Deal in HubSpot for Renewals](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-clone-deal-complete-guide)
How to clone HubSpot deals for renewals without losing line items, ARR fields, owners, dates, or audit history. Covers native cloning, workflows, apps, and API options.

### [HubSpot Deal Cloning Apps Compared](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-deal-cloning-apps-compared)
Compare CloneNer, Deal Duplicator, Clone a Deal, Clone Attack, and native HubSpot workflows: pricing, features, object coverage, limitations, and which one fits HubSpot teams that need clean renewal deals with line items.

### [Copy Deal Properties in HubSpot Workflows](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-copy-deal-properties-workflow)
HubSpot's Copy Property action updates the enrolled deal, not the new renewal deal. Use these workflow patterns to copy ARR, contract term, renewal date, and owner fields safely.

### [Cloning Deals with Line Items](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-clone-deal-line-items)
HubSpot workflows cannot copy deal line items into renewal deals. Compare marketplace apps, Zapier, custom code, and API options for preserving products, pricing, and quantities.

### [Deal Duplication Best Practices](https://swotbee.com/posts/hubspot-deal-duplication-best-practices)
When to clone vs. create fresh, naming conventions, which properties to copy, how cloning affects forecasting: the governance framework nobody else covers.
